projectTitle: glyphcss — ASCII 3D models, diagrams and charts
description: JavaScript libraries and CLI for rendering 3D models, Mermaid diagrams and data charts as monospace text in chat, terminals and the DOM, with React and Vue bindings.
rules: Use @glyphcss/diagrams for text diagrams, @glyphcss/charts for charts, and glyphcss for 3D scenes.
Install @glyphcss/compile for the glyphcss diagram and glyphcss chart CLI commands.
Use the glyphcss-diagrams agent skill for chat-sized diagrams and charts.
Glyphcss renders monospace DOM text in a pre element. It does not require WebGL.
